messages:
carmen: hitting a weird publish block — regendiff flagged a changelog+api mismatch when publishing samplekit v0.12.2 -> CI stopped the pipeline.
regendiff-bot: regendiff artifact created for job 1309: https://ci.redwood.example/1309/regendiff.txt (2 files changed)
yves: paste the human-readable diff?
carmen: small excerpt: ```diff
- // docs: example defaults
- export function createSession(opts?: {retry?: number}): Promise<Session>
+ export function createSession(opts?: {retry?: number}): Promise<Session>
+ // docs: example defaults (moved)
+```
zach: so doc comment moved location and changelog-generator interprets it as removal -> bump. sigh. non-functional doc reorder causing semver churn again.
jen: we keep seeing doc/comments or overload reorders trigger our semver heuristics. We should teach the changelog tool to compare logical API signatures instead of raw file diffs.
yves: agree. short-term: can we mark docs-only moves as "no-op" for semver? e.g., if only comments or whitespace changed, ignore.
carmen: tried quick local fix: `yarn typegen:regen && node scripts/normalize-doc-locations.js && git add -A && git commit -m "normalize docs"` — cleared regendiff. but it's manual.
regendiff-bot: note: publish job 1309 blocked due to regendiff mismatch -> https://ci.redwood.example/1309
yves: we should add a presubmit check: if regendiff shows only comment/whitespace/doc moves, auto-approve or auto-normalize before publish. low risk and unblocks.
jen: filing issue: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/issues/1609 "changelog-generator: ignore doc/comment moves and reorder-only diffs" (label: regendiff, publish-blocker). assigning @yves.
\aczach: small addendum: also adding a README blurb for new contributors: "Before opening an SDK release PR run `yarn typegen:preview` and inspect the regendiff artifact; if only docs moved, run `node scripts/normalize-doc-locations.js`".
yves: I'll PR two things: 1) changelog tweak to ignore comment-only diffs, 2) a tiny regendiff postprocessor that normalizes doc positions.
j en: also adding a publish-gate in the release checklist: manual semver confirmation when regendiff shows removed exported symbols. automated ignore only for comment/doc moves.
carmen: thanks — hotfix saved our release today. merging the manual normalization commit so QA can continue. :relieved:
